Press a shortcut, drag a box, and the recording starts. Click Stop and the video's path is on your clipboard, ready to paste into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any other agent.

**Downloads**

- **macOS** (14+, Apple Silicon): `Rec_<version>_aarch64.dmg`. Rec isn't notarized by Apple yet, so the first time macOS says it "could not verify" the app: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Once only; updates install from inside Rec.
- **Windows** (10 2004+ / 11, x64): `Rec_<version>_x64-setup.exe`. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn: click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux** (x64): `Rec_<version>_amd64.deb` for Debian/Ubuntu, or the `.AppImage`. On Wayland the system asks which screen to share the first time you record.

Everything stays on your computer: no account, no uploads, no analytics.
